header:
Awesome Customer Support

> Open-source helpdesks, live chat, chatbots, knowledge bases and feedback tools for support teams. Every entry shows its license. **Rules of this list:** every repo exists, is public, is not archived, states a license and has had a commit in the last year. One plain sentence each. Star counts and claims are the authors' own, we did not test every tool. Checked 2026-10-18. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md).
footer:
## How to choose

- **Keep a human path.** Every bot should hand off to a person.
- **Check data location** if you store customer messages.
- **Track a few numbers:** first reply time, resolution time, satisfaction.
- **Check the license** and who owns the hosted version.

## Contributing

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md). One entry per pull request, plain words, real sources only.
